svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Mockup 21: the storyboard preset picker with on and off per event
svg.text: 21 · The preset picker: every built-in, on or off per event

g.text: Built-ins are copied into the event on first use; a later platform version never changes them.
on by default · idle where the trigger never comes
off by default · turn on what fits the venue

A row opens the builder. A built-in can be duplicated to edit a copy, or edited and later reset to default. Turning on a preset that overlaps a built-in rule turns the rule off for this event, and back.
